The best value under ₹50,000 is the MSI Modern 14 at ₹43,219 because it is the only one here with 16GB RAM. The other two are the Acer Aspire Lite 15 at ₹42,990 and the Dell DC15255 at ₹47,990.

Laptop	Price	Processor	RAM / Storage	Screen
MSI Modern 14 C7M-062IN	₹43,219	Ryzen 5 7530U	16GB / 512GB SSD	14 inch
Acer Aspire Lite 15 AL15-41	₹42,990	Ryzen 5 5625U	8GB / 512GB SSD	15 inch
Dell DC15255	₹47,990	Ryzen 5 7520U	8GB / 512GB SSD	15 inch
MSI: Most RAM for the money and a newer chip. It was listed in Mar 2023, so check that stock is still new.
Acer: Cheapest of the three and a good pick if 8GB is enough for you.
Dell: The newest, listed in Sep 2025, but you pay about ₹4,800 more than the Acer for the same RAM.

Prices come from one list on Smartprix, updated on Tue 27 Oct 2026, so shop prices may differ. Screen sizes come from the AI names; the page gave no screen quality details.
